interpretation_notes: Current source remains dci-mvp-v3.4-pilot; the images describe the proposed freeze and do not change protocol state.
65536 is the context length of the current confirmation backend; 128000 is the cumulative per-query acceptance limit.
The v5 reserve has a 32000-token floor and forecasts a next search/read, final and one repair; the system permits up to three repairs within the original shared budgets.
Only controller finalization and its repair path disable tools and use the selective prompts; ordinary repair of a natural final can continue searching.
A nonempty read receipt is a sample-level gate. It is not a relevance proof and does not require every returned document to be individually read.
read is a host Node corpus-only operation; bash is executed inside Bubblewrap. Inspect local transport is not the security boundary.
qrels are host-only, available for host preflight and post-generation scoring, never exposed to the agent or model.
The illustrated Atlas query, documents, decisions and final ranking are fictional teaching material, not saved benchmark observations.
